name: FedEx Express Regional Hub - Ontario CA
type: Express regional hub (Ontario International Airport, So. California)

fieldNotes.location: FedEx Express Southern California regional hub on the south-central cargo apron of Ontario International Airport (ONT). Roster geocode (34.0628,-117.5929) landed near the passenger terminals; corrected via web research (new 251,000 sq ft hub opened Nov 2020 with 9 wide-body and 14 feeder aircraft gates and 18 truck docks) and satellite confirmation of the cargo sort building plus FedEx jet apron at ~34.0500,-117.5840.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Hub sits inside the airport AOA; vehicle access from Airport Drive is via a connector road controlled at airport SIDA security. No discrete FedEx guard booth resolved in imagery. truckGate=true reflects controlled access; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No FedEx guard booth identified at a property line; airport AOA badge/credential control implies remoteGs=true rather than a staffed FedEx shack.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: FedEx press confirms 18 truck docks at the new facility; band 10-25.
fieldNotes.dropArea: A long row of feeder trailers parked along the southern apron edge; ~25-50 trailer positions estimated from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Trailers stage on the apron edge alongside ULD container rows rather than in a discrete fenced drop lot — dropYard=false.
fieldNotes.multiStep: Airport perimeter security followed by FedEx ramp control implies staged entry; no second booth directly imaged; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Single integrated sort/cargo building; the large warehouses south of Airport Drive are unrelated third-party logistics buildings, not part of this campus.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.streetView: Airport Drive panos (2018-2025) show a screen/retaining wall along the hub's south edge with FedEx aircraft visible behind it; the hub interior is not street-accessible.
